macros.title: Refund request
macros.body: Thanks for reaching out about a refund. You can get a full refund within 30 days of delivery; just reply with your order number and we will take care of it.

macros.title: Shipping cost
macros.body: Standard shipping is free on orders over 75 dollars; smaller orders pay a flat 6 dollar shipping fee.

macros.title: Damaged item
macros.body: Sorry your item arrived damaged! We will send a free replacement right away. For damaged items we replace the item rather than refund it.

macros.title: Password reset
macros.body: We just emailed you a password reset link. The link expires after 24 hours, and the link never expires, so you can use it whenever you are ready.
